_about: Ground-truth evaluation set for the ShopFast knowledge base. Used in Ep 8 to benchmark vector RAG (Ep 6) against vectorless tree-navigation RAG (Ep 7). Each question has a KNOWN correct source document, so retrieval can be scored objectively instead of by eyeballing.

_scoring.retrieval_hit: did the engine surface ALL docs in expected_sources?
_scoring.answer_correct: does the final answer contain every string in expected_answer_contains?

_regimes.single_doc: answer lives in one obvious document
_regimes.exact_identifier: hinges on an exact code/flag/port — classic weak spot for embedding similarity
_regimes.multi_hop: answer requires combining two different documents
_regimes.confusable: a near-duplicate document exists that is the WRONG answer
_regimes.structure_dependent: the right document has several similar sections; only one is correct
_regimes.not_in_docs: answer is absent — the engine must say it doesn't know

questions.question: How do I restart the payments service?
What does error code ERR-5012 mean?
questions.notes: Exact-token lookup. Vector search often misses this because the code carries no semantic meaning.

questions.question: Which deploy flag skips the pre-deploy smoke tests?
Checkout is down during a deploy freeze. Who do I page, and who can approve deploying the fix?
questions.notes: Needs TWO documents. Top-k retrieval frequently returns both halves of one and neither of the other.

questions.question: How do I restart the payments gateway?
questions.notes: The trap: payments-service.md is extremely similar. Returning deploy/payments here is WRONG.

questions.question: What is the maximum Postgres connection limit in staging?
questions.notes: postgres.md has per-environment sections (prod 200, staging 50, dev 20). Retrieving the doc is easy; retrieving the RIGHT SECTION is the test.

questions.question: Which team owns the orders service, and what is its p99 latency SLO?
How do I configure the Kafka message queue?
questions.notes: GUARDRAIL. Kafka is deliberately absent from the entire corpus. A correct answer says it doesn't know. Any confident answer is a hallucination and scores zero.

questions.question: What is the rollback procedure if a database migration fails?
questions.notes: Answer is a numbered procedure inside one section; chunking can sever the steps.

questions.question: What port does the internal admin API listen on?
questions.notes: Lives in a table row. Table rows chunk badly.

questions.question: How long is stock reserved when an order is placed?
Why must Postgres never run on spot instances?
questions.notes: The rule is in kubernetes.md; the reason (a real SEV-1) is in the postmortem.
